subject: POC: traffic sizing & milestones for Ava Solutions
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Malik <sara@avasolutions.com>, Tim Nolan <tim.nolan@avasolutions.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-11T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: POC: traffic sizing & milestones for Ava Solutions

Thanks again for the call this morning — good sync. Quick recap and a few concrete asks so we can get the POC scheduled and scoped.

Call recap (short):
- Goal: validate integration and cost/latency profile for your text-generation API (customer-facing chat + batched summarization).
- High-level constraints you mentioned: SLO target is 95th percentile latency under 350ms for single-turn queries; some longer summarization jobs are OK to be slower.

What we need from you to size the trial: please send a small traffic snapshot (CSV is ideal) with the following fields for representative requests:
- timestamp, endpoint (chat|summarize), request_tokens, response_tokens, headers size (approx), per-request concurrency id if available
- OR just answers to these bullets if CSV is not handy: baseline RPS, typical concurrency, 95th token lengths, peak burst RPS and typical burst duration

Proposed POC structure (draft):
- Duration: 3 weeks (baseline -> load -> validation/hardening)
- Success criteria (draft): latency SLO, accuracy/QoR pass rate on your eval set, and an agreed-upon cost-per-1k-tokens threshold
- Ownership: Jordan (customer ops & overall), Ben (load & infra validation), Soojin (integration & runtime config)

Attachments: call_notes_20270411.txt (internal notes).

Could you send the traffic snapshot and any sample prompts/templates by end of day tomorrow? If next Monday (2027-04-18) works for a formal POC start, we can lock dates and get engineering time reserved.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0199

From: Sara Malik <sara@avasolutions.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tim Nolan <tim.nolan@avasolutions.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-11T13:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC: traffic sizing & milestones for Ava Solutions

Thanks Jordan — great summary and appreciate the clarity. Attaching an initial snapshot (ava_traffic_snapshot_v1.csv) — it's a 24-hour extract from our staging gateway with anonymized IDs. Highlights below:

Traffic snapshot (24h):
- baseline sustained RPS: ~15 req/s (mostly chat endpoint)
- typical concurrency during business hours: 30-45 concurrent sessions
- average request tokens (prompt): 120 tokens
- 95th percentile total tokens (request+response): ~700 tokens
- peak burst observed (abnormal traffic): up to 450 req/s for ~90–150 seconds (rare, triggered by promotions)
- batch/summary jobs: sent nightly in batches of 150–200 requests, avg tokens ~2,500 (these can be scheduled outside POC window)

Constraints & notes:
- Auth: Bearer token header (~512 bytes) — will provide a staging token for POC.
- We do want streaming for chat use-cases to render partial responses where latency matters.
- Success criteria from our side: 95th pctl latency for interactive chat under 350ms for requests under 500 tokens; batch jobs completed within an agreed throughput window; no functional regressions on our intent/eval set (>95% pass).

I'll attach a short procurement note on contract timing — procurement prefers a three-week trial with an interim check at the end of week 2.

Attached: ava_traffic_snapshot_v1.csv and a procurement-timing note.

—Sara
Sara Malik
Head of Product | Ava Solutions
sara@avasolutions.com | +1 (212) 555-0123

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Sara Malik <sara@avasolutions.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC: traffic sizing & milestones for Ava Solutions

Thanks for the snapshot, Sara — that's very helpful. A couple of clarifying Qs from infra/load perspective before we finalize the MOP: 

1) Streaming: you indicated streaming is required for some chat flows. Which endpoints must have streaming enabled in the POC (chat only, or also summarize)?
2) Auth header size confirmed ~512 bytes — thanks. Do you also use any large custom metadata headers per request?
3) Warm-up: do you have a canonical warm-up workload or synthetic seed we can use to populate KV caches and prefix caches? If not, we typically recommend a 10–20 minute warm-up at ~1.5x baseline before load runs.

Draft POC success criteria (propose we, customer, agree these formally):
- Latency: 95th percentile interactive chat < 350ms for requests <= 500 tokens
- Stability: no more than 2 incidents causing >5% error rate during load windows in POC period
- Cost: token-inference cost delta vs. baseline below agreed threshold (TBD in final doc)
- Quality: on your eval set, model outputs meet your pass criteria >95% (we'll collect 200 samples for evaluation)

Suggested timeline & owner matrix: 
- Week 0 (2027-04-18 to 2027-04-24): integration + warm-up; owner: Soojin (integration), Ben (load harness setup)
- Week 1 (2027-04-25 to 2027-05-01): controlled RPS ramp to baseline and then step to peak bursts; owner: Ben
- Week 2 (2027-05-02 to 2027-05-08): hardening, QoR checks, cost tuning, and run-of-record for acceptance; owner: Jordan & Soojin

Telemetry plan (we'll need):
- per-request trace IDs included in logs (provide mapping file)
- token-level counts and aggregate per-minute RPS and latencies
- a short list of ~10 representative prompts for QoR checks (Sara — can you confirm?)

I'll build a short MOP PDF and attach v1 for internal review; will include exact load windows.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Performance Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Malik <sara@avasolutions.com>, Tim Nolan <tim.nolan@avasolutions.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-12T16:23:00-07:00
Subject: Confirming POC start date & Milestones — next steps

Great alignment — thanks all. Confirming next steps and owners so we can lock calendar and onboarding slots.

Agreed start: Monday 2027-04-18. Duration: 3 weeks (ends 2027-05-08) with a week-2 check-in.

Mutual action plan (short):
- Before start (by 2027-04-15): Ava -> provide final traffic CSV+10 eval prompts + staging auth token. Redwood -> provide MOP v1, test build notes, and reserved infra slots.
- Week 0 (integration/warm-up): Soojin to run integration checklist and confirm streaming paths; Ben to run 20-min warm-up and validate KV cache behavior.
- Week 1 (ramp/load): Ben to execute step-ramp tests including a single 2-minute spike at 450 RPS; Jordan to coordinate on-call window and customer observation.
- Week 2 (acceptance runs + QoR): collect 200 QoR samples, compare against your pass criteria; if pass -> provide trial readout and cost analysis.

Attachments: poc_moplist_v1.pdf (MOP + load windows), call_notes_20270411.txt, ava_traffic_snapshot_v1.csv (from Sara). I've also added the HubSpot deal and the mutual action plan link above.

Sara — if this matches your expectations, can you confirm the staging token and the 10 eval prompts by EOD Thursday 2027-04-15? Once confirmed I'll create the calendar invites for the week-0 kickoff and the week-2 demo.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0199
